notes.title: New Hotfix
notes.content:
General Fixes & Improvements

Fixed an issue where selecting Chinese or Russian would cause the in-game language to automatically revert to English.

Fixed the problem where the Hint section in Deck appeared as a question mark.

The Bristle’s Vision Set Glasses skin is now attached to the ear and moves along with it.

notes.title: Hotfix: Fair Play, Poker Fixes & Brown Box Bug Resolved
notes.content:
Fair Play

Exploits related to the God Save mechanic have been blocked.



Gameplay Update (Poker)

Fixed an issue where the round would reset if losing players left the game while on the All-In screen.



General Fixes & Improvements

Fixed an issue where Chinese characters were displayed as squares in the lobby and in-game.

Fixed the “brown box” screen issue that some players were experiencing.

Minor bugs and localization issues have been fixed.

Fixed an issue in Matchmaking Poker where cards would not appear during switching.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206608/362538030652103f26e8b966934b03e306af0359.png"]

Toska Bar: Step into a brand-new bar! Toska -a fight for survival inside a cold, dangerous snow-covered train. This is the ultimate high-stakes environment for the bold.



New Lobby Track: “Red Snow” sets the perfect mood for the Soviet Train Bar, making every game feel intense and immersive.



Free Skins: A brand-new skin set is available to all players at no cost! Customize your style and stand out at the table.



Ban System: A new system will fully roll out within 2 weeks. Hackers and cheaters will be permanently removed from matchmaking to keep the game fair for everyone.



Lots of localization and language fixes have been made.

notes.title: Hotfix – Lobby Connection Bug Resolved
notes.content:
Players should now be able to enter lobbies without issue.

Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Yet another hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes & Improvements:
Combination Ranking

Corrected ranking errors for hand combinations on the Reveal screen.

Chat Freeze

Resolved an issue where using chat would freeze the game timer.

Switch Card Selection

Fixed a bug that caused the wrong card to be selected during a Switch.

Table vs. Reveal Display

Ensured cards look the same at the table and on the Reveal screen.

Tusk Audio

Addressed a few sound issues with Tusk.

All-In Exit Crash

Fixed a game-breaking crash when a player who was supposed to shoot themselves on All-In left the match.

Animation Glitches

Squashed several animation bugs throughout the game.

Poker Guide Descriptions

Fixed the duplicate descriptions for Four of a Kind and Full House in the in-game Poker Guide.

notes.title: Liar's Poker hotfix is here!
notes.content:
Poker mode has been refined for a smoother and more stable experience.


Bug Fixes & Improvements:
Ace now correctly counts as 1 when needed.

Fixed major bugs causing the game to freeze during ALL-IN.

Fixed turn freezing issues when using Switch Card.

Folded players no longer participate in the Reveal phase.

Fixed several timer-related bugs.

Prevented actions like Call while typing in the chat.

Fixed an issue where nicknames didn’t fully fit in the UI.

Added Poker Hints — press F1 during the game to see them.

Fixed various lobby UI bugs.

Resolved animation issues with Tusk.

Fixed some character animations.



Punching bag sound has been toned down. Your ears can rest easy now.

notes.title: Liar's Poker has arrived!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206608/31bc0b499cf9a10099f5450cf400e27f6787d980.jpg"]

New Game: LIAR’S POKER!


A brand new game has hit the table — Liar’s Poker!


With it, Liar’s Poker Matchmaking is now live, featuring cheat protection to ensure a fair and thrilling experience.


The Liar’s Deck Beta Season has ended and Season 1 has now officially begun. The top players of the Beta have marked their names on the Legendsboard.


Bug Fixes
We’ve resolved several key issues to improve the overall experience:

Fixed an issue where matchmaking could start with missing players.

Reworked score calculation: players now earn points based on how many opponents they’ve sat at the table with.

Ongoing improvements to prevent cheating and exploit abuse.


Coming Soon to the Table
Liar’s Dice Matchmaking — a remastered and competitive version of the classic experience.

New Bar: Soviet Train — a one-of-a-kind bar built inside a moving train.

Velvet Room — a luxurious lounge where Riva performs in her way while two players compete under her gaze.

And of course — many bug fixes, including improvements to matchmaking stability and cheat protection.

notes.title: The Matchmaking Beta is Now Available!
notes.content:
The new non-host-based system introduces ranked matches, enhancing the competitive experience.
 Currently, the Matchmaking system supports up to 3,000 simultaneous players. Within a week, this capacity will be increased to accommodate more players.

notes.title: WHOOA IT’S BIG!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206608/c5ce6edc062c63cdd9d381c7837f69751691a580.png

The doors to the new bar have swung open, but don’t expect a warm welcome. It may look fresh on the outside, but inside, the same dirty games are being played—this time with a twist.   

Welcome to the Arcade Bar, where anything can happen... if you survive. 


You asked for it, and we delivered the chaotic, adrenaline-fueled experience you’ve been craving: The new Chaos Mode Ruleset. It’s no longer just about bluffing—now, it’s personal.  

Here’s what’s new in Chaos Ruleset: 

 Call someone a liar? If you’re right, you get to decide who to shoot. Choose wisely, or don’t—chaos doesn’t play favorites. 
 Master card in play? The Master wields the power to decide who faces the trigger. 
 Chaos card appears? Let’s just say everyone gets their moment in the spotlight... and their finger on the trigger. AT THE SAME TIME. 

The excitement starts now. 

Meet Kudo (the Devious Red Panda). The sharp-witted regular of Liar’s Bar is here to shake things up. Always one step ahead, juggling lies, debts, and a family of chaos – all while plotting his next big con.

Host Migration Is Finally Here!
No more games ending just because the host couldn’t handle the pressure! If the host leaves, a new one will take their place, ensuring the game continues. 

This feature is currently in beta, so you might encounter some minor hiccups. Don’t worry—our team is on it, and we’ll fine-tune everything in the coming days. Your feedback is always welcome as we perfect the experience. 

Bug Fix in Dice. We’ve resolved a pesky issue to make your gameplay smoother. 

Foxy’s Outfit Updated. A fresh look for our sly fox—check it out! 

Improved Lobby Animations. Characters now have enhanced animations to bring them to life while you wait. 

Redesigned Lobby. The lobby has been rebuilt with a new design. 

New Music Added. 

New Characters in Arcade Bar. Encounter intriguing new faces as you explore the second bar. 

New Dialogue Lines. Characters now have additional lines, helping you uncover more about their backstories. 

New Card Backs. Enjoy new card designs in your games. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206608/b249494285d9fb47f3750251f1a35c377df56765.png

notes.title: Get ready! November 27th – Liar’s Bar update drops and it’s BIG!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206608/c5ce6edc062c63cdd9d381c7837f69751691a580.png
Get ready! November 27th – Liar’s Bar update drops and it’s BIG! 

New Bar, Same Dirty Games: The Arcade Bar is now open—but it’s not all fun and games. Enter if you dare… 

Chaos Mode: No more just bluffing—now, it’s personal. 

Meet Kudo: The slick, sharp-tongued red panda is in town, and he’s got his eyes on the prize.

notes.title: Traditional Mode Update for Liar’s Dice
notes.content:
We've resolved an issue in the Traditional Ruleset of Liar’s Dice where one's weren’t appearing on the screen during counting. This bug has now been fixed, so all dice values should display correctly in your games.

Thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Spot On and Mode Filter Update in Liar’s Dice
notes.content:
Based on your feedback, we’ve improved and developed the Spot On mechanic in Liar's Dice! Now, after the previous player has made their move, you have three options: 


 Raise the bid 
 Call them a liar 
 Or declare Spot On! 


If you say Spot On! and the previous player's guess is exactly right, then everyone else drinks—except you. However, if the guess is not Spot On, you’ll be the one drinking. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206608/d55598e33c587a52b12a18d91cbae8680e64f5d9.png

Now you can filter the game mode you want to play in the lobby list.

Plus in Liar’s Deck Devil Ruleset, if you have played all your cards, you’re safe from the Devil card. 

We’ve also enhanced some animations for the new characters. 

We’ve resolved issues related to saving settings.

notes.title: Update Alert: New Game Rulesets, Characters, and More
notes.content:
We’ve got some exciting news for all liars out there! This latest update brings a whole bunch of new content and improvements: 

New Game Modes: 

 Liar’s Deck - Devil Ruleset: Play the Devil card to force your opponents into a deadly game of Russian Roulette! 
 Liar’s Dice - Traditional Ruleset: Guess the exact number of dice and watch everyone else drink poison if you're “Spot on”! 1 is a wildcard now. This means it can count as any number you want.

Thank you for your continued support. Stay tuned for more content, locations, and characters coming your way soon. We’re doing everything we can to give you the best experience possible.

Best, 
The Liar's Bar Team

notes.title: Lobby bugs, ranking bugs, etc. hotfix
notes.content:
Dear Liars, 

We would like to share that we’ve made hotfix on some of the issues you've been experiencing. Here's what we’ve tackled so far: 


 Most of the lobby bugs have been fixed. We'll be keeping an eye on them and working to resolve any problems that may come up. 
 We’ve resolved the issue where progress (like ranking) wasn’t being saved properly in the database. 
 The bug where music settings reset every time you reopen the game has been fixed. 
 Dead players will no longer be able to see other players’ cards while in spectator mode. 
 The issue where pressing "Enter" in chat during the game would cause players to disconnect has been fixed. 


We sincerely apologize for the bad experience some of you had while these issues were ongoing. As a small indie studio with a limited team, it took us a bit longer to address everything, but we truly appreciate your patience throughout this process. 

We still have a list of bugs we are actively working on, and in the next few days, we aim to fix most of them based on your feedback. On the next update, we will be upgrading the new lobby features and add voice chat. 

Once all the bugs are resolved, we’ll be adding some exciting new features to the game. The art team have already started working on new characters and thematic new bars to lie in! A new feature is coming to Liar’s Deck… and let’s just say, soon you’ll have the chance to pull the trigger on everyone at the table. 

Thank you for sticking with us, and for being so understanding. We couldn’t do this without your support! 

Best, 
The Liar's Bar Team
